checks: Library upload stays on page; two real local files produce distinct ready images with authenticated thumbnails; closing restores focus and preserves the pending draft.
Background upload survives library/album client navigation and a later visibility change; the two persisted images retain the settings frozen at Start.
Removing the real default storage disables Start without choosing another enabled storage; restoring it and reopening recovers the same pending draft.
The picker renders all three real uploaded thumbnails and disables the current album member; its empty album has no redundant subtitle.

Album upload freezes its automatic relation, survives a confirmed rejection, retries retained bytes and refreshes the actual album count and cover; library and album drafts remain isolated across client navigation.

A real album retry remains in the background while client navigation returns to /albums; releasing its accepted preparation response automatically changes the current list from zero to one image and loads the actual saved cover without reopening or reloading the page.
limitations: Desktop Chromium emulation, not physical mobile hardware. Real local uploads are exercised; remote S3 protocol is unchanged and not retested by this suite.

checks: Only selected images expose the toolbar action menu; public/no-album selection hides redundant public/remove actions. Right-click contains only five common actions and Escape restores card focus.

Private-only selection hides private; mixed selection exposes both choices. The confirmed public mutation sends only the one private ID, retains both matching selections and refreshes menu eligibility from real metadata.

Library removal requires an explicitly chosen target and leaves the other album intact. Album-context removal has no target list, freezes only the current album, removes its out-of-query selection and never deletes the image.
Explicit membership reads disable existing images; two selected images survive distinct searches and page 1 → page 2.
A rejected real command preserves both selected IDs, the search and the current page; the album remains unchanged.

After a real join commits but its response is lost, the picker only reads back once, creates no duplicate join, closes in the same album, restores focus and refreshes its real count/automatic-cover identity.

A real first-image join plus a second-image failure followed by a detail HTTP 500 keeps the picker mounted, the failed image selected and the refresh error visible; explicit retry adds only the retained failure and refreshes the real count.
A membership-read failure hides selectable choices and remains actionable; retry restores the actual existing-member badge, and Escape restores the Add Images trigger.
